comment: C3 label sweep on Ada (ucrtasl). ENGINEERING_ONLY config; the sweep output is PILOT label data. AI-assisted (Claude), 22 Oct 2026. Schema: r1/scripts/c3_label_sweep.py DEFAULTS (unknown top-level keys are refused). Validate with: python r1/scripts/c3_label_sweep.py --config r1/scripts/configs/c3_sweep_ada.json --check-config. NODES: the D21 noise nodes (PLAN §10 D21; R1-E1B-RERUN2 revision 'nodes per D21'). The liveness phase runs D28 on all of them first (memory on, 2 instances, W = 10); a node that fails is excluded from BOTH memory modes (runner behaviour), which keeps digits_mlp out of memory-on collection until D28 passes (PLAN §10, digits_mlp 22 Oct) and leaves the memory-off-only vs exclusion choice to the author. openml_ionosphere stays in: it passed D28 on 14 Oct (liveness_llm_20261014T140742Z); its 19 Oct exclusion concerns the DI-test eligible pool (no decision-changed points), not C3 labels. NODES_PENDING: the slot for the 22 Oct node-pool candidates; they are NOT run. Move a node from nodes_pending into nodes only after the parallel 30-seed 'vary' noise re-measurement shows it qualifies under D21 (and the C3 pipeline knows the node: r1/c3/features.py NODE_INFO). AUDIT: K = 10 fresh joint seeds 7001..7010, first 5 label, last 5 evaluation (C3_DESIGN §4); recorded in the manifests and the sweep index for r1/c3/audit.py. PAPER A: r1/scripts/paper_a_status.py with its Ada config, which refuses until its null entries are verified on Ada. OLLAMA: pinned qwen2.5-coder:7b (digest pinned in the runner), own port, own models dir under the batch directory seeded by hard links from the batch-1 pinned model files (verify the path on Ada; the runner checks the digest and refuses on a mismatch).
